hook.label: The question we help answer.
hook.heading: Is your current path on track for where you want to go?
hook.lead: Most people have a variety of financial pieces: an IRA, a 401(k), an insurance policy, Social Security, and maybe a pension. Few have a plan that connects them all.
hook.body: We start with the life you want your money to support, look at whether your current direction gets you there, and build one plan where every piece works together.

whoWeServe.heading: We help people live on purpose, not by default.
whoWeServe.body:
Whether you're approaching retirement, already there, or still building toward it, we help you make thoughtful decisions about how your money supports your life.

The work changes depending on where you are. The goal is a plan that helps you understand what comes next and how the pieces fit together.

leadMagnet.label: Free Guide
leadMagnet.heading: Not ready to talk? Start with the guide.
leadMagnet.body: A short guide to help you evaluate whether your money is working together the way you intend, especially as retirement gets closer.

order.label: How we think
order.heading: Purpose first. Then balance, protect, save, and grow.

items.title: Purpose
items.desc: What you want your money to support.

items.title: Balance
items.desc: Spending and saving that can sustain it.

items.title: Protect
items.desc: Guarding against what could knock it off course.

items.title: Save
items.desc: A reserve you can reach when life happens.

items.title: Grow
items.desc: Long-term investing for the goals further out.

order.closing: We work on them together, because each one affects the others.
order.button: How we think about each piece

philosophy.label: Why We Exist
philosophy.quote: Money on its own doesn't mean much. What matters is what it lets you do, who it lets you take care of, and the life it helps you live.
philosophy.body: We started One Life Advisory because we believe a financial plan should start with purpose, not products. One plan. Built around your purpose, designed to support the life you want. Not just until you retire, but for every year after.

finalCta.label: Get Started
finalCta.heading: Ready to talk?
finalCta.sub: The first step is a free Clarity Call. We'll spend 15 to 30 minutes talking about what's on your mind, what you're trying to accomplish, and whether we may be able to help.

hero.sub: All the pieces of your financial puzzle - organized and working together.

covers.label: What We Do
covers.heading: What a plan with us covers
covers.sub:
Every part of the plan connects back to the life your money needs to support. We call the income your plan is designed to support over time your Future Cash Flow.

The rest of the plan helps us understand how to build it, support it, and adjust it as life changes.

cards.title: Liquidity & Cash Flow
cards.desc: Understanding what your money is doing today and planning for the income you'll need over time.

cards.title: Protection
cards.desc: Life insurance, disability, long-term care, and the coverage in between. A plan that holds up no matter what life brings.

cards.title: Investments
cards.desc: Portfolios built to support the income your plan needs to produce — not the other way around.

cards.title: Retirement Income
cards.desc: A personalized strategy to turn your savings into income designed to last.

cards.title: Forward-Looking Tax Planning
cards.desc: Most planning decisions carry tax consequences. We weigh them every step of the way so they're built into the plan, not handled after the fact.

cards.title: Legacy
cards.desc: What you leave behind, and to whom, and how. Family, the people you love, the causes that matter to you.

planPreview.label: How We Plan
planPreview.heading: Our planning process starts with you, not your accounts.
planPreview.body: Five stages, from the first conversation through the years that follow. You'll see where you stand and how we plan before you decide anything.

steps.title: Clarity Call
steps.desc: A short call to see whether we're a good fit.

steps.title: Discovery Meeting
steps.desc: What you want from your life, and your financial picture.

steps.title: Planning Conversation
steps.desc: Where you stand, how we plan, and the direction we'd suggest.

steps.title: Onboarding & Implementation
steps.desc: Putting strategies in place, some now and some over time.

steps.title: Ongoing Support & Reviews
steps.desc: Continuing to improve the plan as life changes.

seo.description: One Life Advisory builds financial plans around your purpose, bringing cash flow, investments, protection, taxes, and legacy together into one plan.
